text:
tian.w: Hi all, quick onboarding snag. I accepted the GitHub org invite yesterday from my phone but I can't access private repos (404 on clone). I did SSO via Okta and set up TOTP 2FA. Any ideas?

ops-admin: Welcome @tian.w! First thing: in the org people list, does your account show as Member or Outside collaborator? Mobile accept sometimes links to a different account.

tian.w: It shows as "Outside collaborator". Weird — I definitely used the invite link HR sent to tian.work@redwood.com. I clicked it on mobile and accepted.

maria.hr: We sent to tian.work@redwood.com per the offer form. Sorry for the churn — sometimes mobile browsers auto-fill with a personal GH session.

dev-lead: If GH attached the invite to another account or treated the click as repo-level access, you'll be external. Two paths: admin remove the external collaborator and re-invite as an org member, OR admin convert via org settings (remove then add as member). Ops usually prefers remove+reinvite.

tian.w: Do I need to do anything on my side? I don't want to accidentally accept the wrong account again.

ops-admin: Best practice: when we re-send, open the invite link in a desktop browser where you're logged into the correct GH account (confirm at github.com by looking at the avatar). If you must use mobile, ensure you switch accounts in the GH mobile UI before accepting. Also verify your work email is listed and verified in Settings -> Emails.

dev-lead: After acceptance, verify SAML is authorized: Settings -> Organizations -> redwood-inference -> click "Authorize" if present. Then confirm teams with `gh api orgs/redwood-inference/teams --paginate` and private repos via `gh repo list redwood-inference --private`.

maria.hr: Filed a request to ops to remove the external collaborator entry for tian.w and reissue the invite to tian.work@redwood.com.

invite-bot: Ticket #4721 created: "mobile-accept -> external collaborator; re-invite required" assigned to infra-admins. ETA: 3 hours.

tian.w: Thanks 97 I'll wait. One more question: I registered a security key and TOTP; could multiple 2FA methods confuse anything?

ops-admin: No, multiple 2FA methods are fine. The issue is account mapping. If you still see 404 after we re-invite, try signing out of github.com, clear cookies, and then sign back in before accepting. That usually clears stale sessions.

dev-lead: If ops tells you it's re-invited, but you still show as external, DM me and I'll check team membership and escalate.

tian.w: Appreciate it, thanks everyone :wave:

invite-bot: Ticket #4721 -> infra-admins. Status: awaiting admin action.
